method: Picture first, then numbers. (1) Looked at the floor-29 overview and rendered the whole east part (east_full.png, --grid 1 --inserts). (2) Rendered 28 tiles of about 5.4 x 5.2 m (--grid 0.5 --inserts --px 2000), 4 columns x 7 rows with small overlaps: columns x 10.8-16.2, 15.8-21.2, 20.8-26.2, 25.8-31.2; rows y -61..-55.8, -56.2..-51, -51.4..-46.2, -46.6..-41.4, -41.8..-36.6, -37..-31.8, -32.2..-29.5 (tiles/t_r{row}_c{col}.png, row 0 = south). Followed every wall, glass line, swing arc and door block in each tile; zoomed again on the NE notch (tiles/z_ne_corner.png). (3) Confirmed from prims.pkl: dumped all A-DOOR / A-DOOR-FRAM / A-GLAZ-CURT / A-WALL / S-COLS / A-FLOR / A-AREA geometry in the box (incl. the linked 2501 / UOBH / Project UOBH blocks), every door INSERT (name, insert point, rotation) and every 90-degree arc of radius 0.4-1.3 m: only the 10 doors listed have door arcs (locker/casework arcs are Q-CASE furniture); the raw DXF has no other door blocks in the box. (4) For each door took a and b from leaf/hinge lines, A-DOOR-FRAM lines and the wall-end hatches (door/frame/jamb or wall-end faces), on the wall or glass-line centre. (5) Independent gap search with shapely over all wall/column/glass hatch ends for collinear gaps of 0.4-4 m: it finds exactly the gaps closed by the listed doors plus open-space ends, no doorless passage. (6) Rendered the part with a marker at every opening centre (east_marked.png) and with both end points of the clusters (tiles/v_cluster_core.png, v_cluster_east.png): every door swing / leaf / slider symbol carries a marker, no unmarked gap. Widths: door leaf(s) plus frame for doors in glass partitions; lift door frame-to-return; walls: wall-end to wall-end.
